fields.System.Title: OUT-403 — Scan-verified pick confirmation
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a picker, I want to confirm a pick by scanning the location and the product, so that
the wrong item or the wrong shelf is caught before it reaches a customer.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a pick line, then confirmation requires scanning the location and the
  • product — neither alone is sufficient.
  • - Given a scan that does not match the task, then the confirmation is rejected and
  • nothing changes.
  • - Given a batch-tracked product, then the allocated batch must also be scanned or
  • confirmed.
  • - Given a valid confirmation, then on-hand and reserved both decrease by the picked
  • quantity, a movement is written, and the line closes — in one transaction.
  • - Given a quantity greater than the task line, then it is rejected.
  • - Given the same confirmation sent twice with one idempotency key, then stock moves
  • once.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | outbound, inventory |
| Tables | pick_task_line, stock_balance, reservation, stock_movement |
| Risks | Confirming a location the picker did not visit ([doc 05 WF 6](../../../docs/05-workflows.md)); on-hand/reserved divergence ([doc 09 §2.3](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)); duplicate confirm ([doc 09 §3.2](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration · idempotency · concurrency · rollback · invariant |
